name: The End and its outer islands

pages.text: Nullscape shapes the End into a more dramatic landscape. Plan your crossings around height changes and gaps, and carry blocks and Ender Pearls for difficult terrain.$(br2)Enter with enough blocks and supplies to recover from an awkward arrival. When fighting the Dragon, watch the crystals, your footing and the space around you.

After the central encounter, the outer islands offer further exploration, End cities, Shulkers and Elytra. Do not let a promising structure distract you from the distance and supplies needed to get home.$(br2)An Elytra is an invitation to plan your flight. Carry suitable propulsion and leave enough reserve to return or land safely.
